suggestions.description: One entry per record you would change. Leave out records that are already clear.

id.description: The id of an existing record. Never invent one.

body.description: The rewritten body. Same facts, same numbers, same organisations — clearer sentences, the outcome first, no filler. If you cannot improve it without adding something, leave this record out entirely.

why.description: One short sentence: what you changed and why.

asks.description: Questions only this person can answer, which would make the record much stronger: 'how many sites?', 'what did the error rate go down to?'. These are asked, never guessed.
